notes:
Batch O (isosorbide-dinitrate, glyceryl-trinitrate, rosuvastatin, ezetimibe, fenofibrate, omega-3-acid-ethyl-esters). All quotes checked FOUND against the fetched text on 2026-10-17 (same normalisation as verify.mjs). BNF/BNFC not accessed (geo-blocked).
SOURCES FROM MHRA PRODUCTS: emc has no glyceryl trinitrate sublingual tablet SmPC, so the two GTN tablet SPCs are MHRA products PDFs (mhraproducts4853 blob URLs), found through the public search index that products.mhra.gov.uk itself uses. The emc Omacor page (product 1706, last updated 2019) predates the 2024 atrial fibrillation update, so the current MHRA Omacor SPC (revised 23/02/2024) is used instead; emc 2836 and 14387 (2024) confirm the atrial fibrillation text.
FORMULATION GAPS: fenofibrate 145 mg (clinic product) has no UK SmPC on emc or MHRA products; the UK 160 mg film-coated tablet SmPC (emc 2198) is used and this is stated in the formulation note. Its renal cap (eGFR 30-59: max 100 mg standard or 67 mg micronised) means both 145 mg and 160 mg tablets exceed the cap. Isosorbide dinitrate: only the 10 mg tablet SmPC (emc 12899) was used; the clinic product is 10 mg.
NOT VERIFIABLE: the GTN tablet 4.8 frequency table is garbled in both PDF texts, so adverseCommon lists effects without frequencies. The GTN elderly rule uses age 65 as a tool trigger; the SPC says only "the elderly" with no age (AUDIT: concern and consequence now say so plainly).
CONFLICTS BETWEEN UK SOURCES (kept as separate items/rules): (1) Rosuvastatin breastfeeding: SmPC not recommended vs SPS preferred statin, use with caution and infant monitoring. (2) Ezetimibe breastfeeding: SmPC should not be used vs SPS can be used with caution (statins preferred). (3) Rosuvastatin renal: SmPC uses creatinine clearance (<30 contraindicated, <60 start 5 mg / no 40 mg); SPS statins monitoring uses eGFR with the same cut-offs; both kept. (4) Rosuvastatin with fibrates: SmPC 40 mg contraindicated and start 5 mg; MHRA DSU 2008 adds do not exceed 20 mg. (5) Omega-3: two UK SmPCs contraindicate soya allergy, the Strides SmPC (emc 14387) does not list soya. (6) Nitrates: angle-closure glaucoma is a caution in the ISDN SmPC but a contraindication in the GTN SPC (and in the batch-B ISMN SmPCs); shock, mitral stenosis, tamponade and severe hypotension are contraindications for ISDN but cautions (4.4) for GTN tablets.
CHANGED UK POSITION TO NOTE: the current rosuvastatin SmPC (emc, Apr 2026) no longer lists pregnancy in 4.3; it says not recommended and stop when pregnancy is recognised, so the rule level is avoid (BUMPS also avoid).
EZETIMIBE 4.3 items that apply only with a statin (pregnancy, breastfeeding, active liver disease) are encoded as: condition active-liver-disease contraindicated (concern says with a statin), pregnancy caution (monotherapy only if clearly necessary; action says contraindicated with a statin), breastfeeding avoid (SmPC says should not be used even alone), plus interaction rule with group:statin.
INTERACTIONS NOT ADDED AS RULES (other side not in master list or not applicable): rosuvastatin with ciclosporin, sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir, ticagrelor, protease inhibitors, gemfibrozil, systemic fusidic acid (the master-list fusidic acid products are topical; the SmPC warning is for systemic formulations only); GTN with heparin, N-acetylcysteine, apomorphine, ergot alkaloids, sapropterin; ISDN with alprostadil, aldesleukin, neuroleptics; fenofibrate with ciclosporin and glitazones; ezetimibe with ciclosporin and cholestyramine. Rosuvastatin with fluconazole and clopidogrel: SmPC says no clinically relevant interaction (item only).
GROUPS: this batch adds members nitrate (isosorbide-dinitrate, glyceryl-trinitrate), statin (rosuvastatin), fibrate (fenofibrate), cyp2c9-inhibitor (fenofibrate). Rules here rely on members defined in other batches: pde5-inhibitor (sildenafil, B), ace-inhibitor, beta-blocker, calcium-channel-blocker, arb, tricyclic-antidepressant, antihypertensive, anticholinergic, anticoagulant and vitamin-k-antagonist (warfarin, C).
NEW CONDITIONS: hocm, myopathy, asian-ancestry, gallbladder-disease, pancreatitis, fish-allergy. Reused: low-cardiac-filling-pressure, mitral-stenosis, constrictive-pericarditis-tamponade, galactose-intolerance-lactase-deficiency (B); severe-anaemia, pulmonary-disease (F); hereditary-sugar-intolerance (G); severe-renal-impairment, uncontrolled-epilepsy (A); active-liver-disease (C); peanut-soya-allergy, severe-infection-shock (D).
Shared sources reused with identical id and URL from batch C: mhra-dsu-statins-interactions-2008, sps-lipid-breastfeeding, sps-statins-liver, sps-statins-monitoring, bumps-statins. No BUMPS leaflet exists for nitrates, fibrates, ezetimibe or omega-3; no SPS breastfeeding page for nitrates, fibrates or omega-3.
Brand-specific prescribing: none stated by any accessed UK source for these medicines. AUDIT 2026-10-17: fenofibrate excipient rules (soya lecithin, lactose) are marked as belonging to the UK 160 mg product; omega-3 pregnancy rule avoid (SmPC "should not be used ... unless clearly necessary"); ISDN ACE-inhibitor rule info (no action stated); see scripts/medcheck-uk/audit/N-O.md.
